$comment: Findings of the DAST run (P8-03c1) looked at and decided. A High is never accepted. Keep a reason anyone can check; remove an entry once its finding is fixed (the run lists entries no finding needed). docs/security/dast.md explains each.

findings.name: Private IP Disclosure
findings.reason: The addresses are examples in help texts (192.168.1.20:8443 for the server, 192.168.1.50 for a printer) that each web app's script carries with the English catalogue of @rp/i18n; no address of a real machine is in it.

findings.name: Private IP Disclosure
findings.reason: The printers' own LAN addresses, which the restaurant set up (P1-07a) and Manage → Kitchen and printers shows; only a signed-in person whose role may manage printers gets them, and they never leave the restaurant's network.

findings.name: Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
findings.reason: The server is on the restaurant's LAN with a certificate from the installation's own CA, and there is no plain-http listener to downgrade to. A browser that remembered HSTS could not open the console after a replaced PC renews the CA, a risk to service (NFR-A01) for no gain; decided in P8-03c1. Cloud surfaces send HSTS.
